 The upload test is flaky on CI: it fails about one run in ten with a lease timeout. Look at how the worker renews its
 lease in src/upload/worker.rs, and why the retry counter can be bumped after the lease check.

 Fix it, add a test that reproduces the race every time, and push a branch named fix/upload-lease. Leave the public
 API as it is.
